answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 644 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the fable log makes public the live set and the glacier audit records each lapse. Keeping 121 aliases alive therefore means 121 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the willow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
